seo.title: Our Services | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Explore ABLEHARBOR remote data entry and virtual assistant support services.

sections.heading: Remote support for the work that keeps your business moving.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR is an independent, remote-first offshore operations support team based in Bangladesh. Our current service areas are Data Entry and Virtual Assistant support. Each project is assessed against the task requirements and available capacity.

sections.heading: How can ABLEHARBOR support your business?
sections.body: Choose the support your business needs.

items.title: Data Entry Services
items.body: Accurate data capture, spreadsheet updates, document processing and structured information entry based on your instructions.

items.title: Virtual Assistant Services
items.body: Task-based remote assistance for administrative activities and routine business operations, shaped around your requirements.

sections.heading: How service onboarding works
sections.body: A clear onboarding process keeps responsibilities, training and quality expectations aligned.

items.title: Explain the task and expectations
items.body: You outline the responsibilities, expected output, working hours, tools and communication requirements.

items.title: Provide task-specific training
items.body: You train the assigned agent on your specific process and provide instructions, examples, SOPs and authorized access.

items.title: Review practice work
items.body: The agent completes sample tasks so you can review their understanding and confirm readiness.

items.title: Begin and monitor regular work
items.body: Once approved, the agent follows the agreed workflow. ABLEHARBOR coordinates communication and progress.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.body: Useful details about our services and working arrangements.

items.title: Can I choose only one service?
items.body: Yes. You can request Data Entry, Virtual Assistant support or a combination, depending on the tasks and agent capabilities required.

items.title: Who trains the assigned agent?
items.body: The client provides task-specific training, instructions, examples and access to the required systems. The agent practices the workflow and the client reviews sample work.

items.title: Can I hire one agent or multiple agents?
items.body: Both arrangements can be discussed. Team size depends on the workload, task complexity, schedule and agreed responsibilities.

items.title: How does ABLEHARBOR work remotely?
items.body: Our team works remotely. We agree on communication, schedules, task instructions and delivery expectations with each client.

items.title: How many people are available?
items.body: Approximately five people are in our available team pool, with one agent available for immediate assignment.

items.title: Can ABLEHARBOR sign an NDA?
items.body: ABLEHARBOR is prepared to review a mutually agreed NDA before confidential information is shared, subject to authorized approval.

sections.heading: Tell us what needs to get done.
sections.body: Share your tasks, expected workload and working requirements. We’ll review the scope and discuss a suitable remote support arrangement.

sections.heading: Common questions. Clear answers.
sections.body: A few useful details about working with ABLEHARBOR.

items.title: Who does ABLEHARBOR work with?
items.body: ABLEHARBOR supports businesses and organizations that need remote data entry or task-based virtual assistant support.

items.title: What services do you provide?
items.body: Our current service areas are Data Entry and Virtual Assistant support. Each project is assessed against the client’s requirements and available capacity.

items.title: Can you support recurring projects?
items.body: Yes. We can discuss recurring and ongoing workflows, with dedicated agents assigned according to the agreed scope and workload.

items.title: How is project capacity determined?
items.body: Around five people are in our available team pool, and one agent is available for immediate assignment. Additional recruitment can be discussed if the project requires more people, but it proceeds only after the client confirms.

items.title: How do you handle quality?
items.body: ABLEHARBOR coordinates communication and progress, while agreed quality checks follow the client’s instructions and acceptance requirements.

items.title: Who provides task-specific training?
items.body: The client provides the training, instructions, examples, SOPs and authorized access needed for its specific workflow.

items.title: Can ABLEHARBOR sign an NDA?
items.body: ABLEHARBOR is prepared to review and sign a mutually agreed Non-Disclosure Agreement before confidential project information is shared, subject to review and authorized approval.

items.title: How can I request a quote?
items.body: Email ABLEHARBOR with your service requirements, expected workload and preferred team arrangement.

items.title: Can you provide more than one dedicated agent?
items.body: Yes, subject to availability and project scope. Additional capacity can be discussed and confirmed before proceeding.

sections.heading: Tell us what support you need.
sections.body: Email us with your task requirements, expected workload, preferred schedule and any tools or systems involved. We will review the scope and discuss the right team arrangement.

seo.title: Remote Data Entry Services | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Structured data entry, PDF and image to spreadsheet conversion, product information entry and quality checks.

sections.heading: Reliable data entry, organized around your workflow.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR provides remote data entry support for businesses that need information captured, organized, updated or transferred into structured formats. Our agents follow your templates, source materials, instructions and agreed quality requirements.

sections.heading: Data entry tasks we can discuss

items.title: Spreadsheet data entry
items.body: Enter, organize, update and format information in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets using your field structure and templates.

items.title: PDF, image and document to spreadsheet
items.body: Transfer readable information from supplied PDFs, scanned documents, photographs, menus and other source files into structured spreadsheets.

items.title: Product information and description entry
items.body: Prepare product names, model details, materials, features, measurements, patterns, categories and descriptions using client-provided references and guidelines.

items.title: Data review and quality checks
items.body: Review entries for completeness, formatting consistency and alignment with source information or client checklists.

sections.heading: Virtual assistant tasks we can discuss

items.title: Administrative assistance
items.body: Organizing information, maintaining records, preparing documents and following established procedures.

items.title: Email and inbox support
items.body: Organizing inboxes, sorting messages, preparing draft responses or flagging items according to client-defined rules.

items.title: Internet research and data collection
items.body: Gathering information from specified sources and preparing structured summaries or spreadsheets.

items.title: Document and file management
items.body: Organizing digital documents, updating records and maintaining agreed naming conventions.

seo.title: NDA & Confidentiality | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Learn about ABLEHARBOR's approach to client confidentiality, agreed access and non-disclosure arrangements.

sections.heading: Your business information deserves careful handling.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR understands that data entry and virtual assistant work may involve access to internal business information. We are prepared to review and sign a mutually agreed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before confidential project information is shared or access is granted, subject to authorized approval.

sections.heading: Our confidentiality approach

items.title: Mutually agreed NDA
items.body: The document, parties, permitted purpose, duration, exclusions and other terms are reviewed and agreed before signature.

items.title: Access based on project responsibilities
items.body: The client and ABLEHARBOR discuss which personnel need access, which systems or files are involved and what actions are permitted.

items.title: Client instructions for information handling
items.body: File-sharing methods, storage locations, communication channels, retention periods and deletion requirements are agreed during onboarding.

items.title: No public use without permission
items.body: Client-provided confidential material and business records are not intentionally used in public marketing without prior permission.
